key_patterns: Design: d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\i18n\.agents\tasks\i18n-phase1\design.md (rev 3, authoritative; section refs §1-§10) + design-review.md NITs (PaymentSettingsModal :341 label via payMethodLabel and rename map var t->pt; invoice-detail badge :3045 via invPayLabel helper; memberTypeDiscountLabel(memberType, uiLang) at WebPOSScreen :2395 and PaymentScreen runCartPromotions lang: uiLang + memo deps). Locales: src/i18n/locales/{th,en}/{common,nav,auth,pos,payment,receipt,receiptScreen,settings}.ts; th `as const` is source of truth; en files annotated LocaleShape<typeof thX>. UiKey = keys not under receipt.*; ReceiptKey = receipt.*; t()/useT() accept UiKey only; useReceiptT().rt accepts ReceiptKey only; translate(lang, key) generic for pure helpers. Pure modules (translate/format/labels/types/locales/memberTypeBenefits/cartAdapter) never import stores or react-native or i18n/index. i18n/index.ts does NOT re-export format.ts. Zustand persist pattern: create()(persist(..., { name, version, storage: createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage), partialize, migrate, merge })) as in src/store/receiptStore.ts. Test mocks for anything reaching persistStorage: vi.mock('react-native', () => ({ Platform: { OS: 'web' } })) and vi.mock('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage', () => ({ default: { getItem: async () => null, setItem: async () => {}, removeItem: async () => {} } })) as in src/store/__tests__/receiptStore.migration.test.ts:7-10. Ambient decl precedent: src/types/xlsx-dist.d.ts. Line numbers in the design refer to HEAD 36e25a3 and drift as you edit — locate by symbol (printReceipt80mm, invoicesFromHistory, voidNote, fullTaxInv, PaymentSettingsModal, MOCK_INVOICES, DEFAULT_PAY_TYPES). logAction sentences and mock product/member/shop data stay Thai. Module constants store keys (labelKey), never t() at module scope.
